prayerExcerpt.en-US: Lord, show us the Father, and we shall be satisfied.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Senhor, mostra-nos o Pai, e isso nos basta.

meta.face: Philip: a beardless young man around 25, somewhat long face, tousled brown forelock parted in two. James the Less: a man around 35, thick dark-brown hair swept back to the shoulders (no centre parting), a short pointed dark-brown beard, rounder face with broad cheekbones, gentle smile.
meta.basis: Philip beardless with a parted forelock; James the Less young with a pointed beard and uncut hair (Painter's Manual, Golden Legend). James is kept from resembling Christ, which the Golden Legend's likeness otherwise invites.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
First edit made James look like Christ; redone with swept-back hair, broader face and a smile
